columnHints.snapshot: The harvest's number at the source. Opens its diagnosis.
columnHints.status: The state in which the source closed the harvest.
columnHints.size: Total records the harvest brought from the source.
columnHints.valid: How many of those records passed validation.
columnHints.invalid: Total minus valid. The source does not report this number; it is computed here.

columnHints.rule: Name of the validation rule applied to this harvest's records.
columnHints.name: What the rule requires of the metadata.
columnHints.mandatory: Whether the rule is mandatory or only optional at the source.
columnHints.validCount: How many of the harvest's records meet the rule. Opens the list already filtered.
columnHints.invalidCount: How many of the harvest's records break the rule. Opens the list already filtered.
columnHints.occurrences: The values found in the rule's field and how often each one appears.

occurrences.title: Occurrences for rule {{rule}}
occurrences.truncated: The source lists at most {{listados}} values; the total adds up only those listed.
occurrences.filtered: Counts within the filters applied on screen.

columnHints.identifier: The record's identifier at the source. Opens the record.
columnHints.valid: Whether the record passed or failed validation in this harvest.
columnHints.transformed: Whether the metadata went through the harvest's transformation.
columnHints.set: Set declared by the source that the record belongs to.
columnHints.details: Opens the record's rule-by-rule validation and the transformed XML.
columnHints.origin: The OAI address this record came from. It may differ from the repository's current registration, when the address changed.
columnHints.prefix: Metadata format the record was harvested in (e.g. oai_dc).

record.title: Record

link.probableHint: Address inferred from the identifier. It could not be confirmed: the server could not reach the repository.

reasons.unreachable: The source repository did not respond.
reasons.no-usable-url: The record metadata carries no usable address.
reasons.oai-error: The source repository refused the query for this record.

record.xmlUnavailable: The Harvester did not return the XML for this record. The diagnosis report is outdated at the source.

recordDiagnosis.title: Validation details
recordDiagnosis.unknownRule: Rule not present in this harvest diagnosis
recordDiagnosis.none: The source recorded no rule evaluation for this record.

columnHints.acronym: The repository's code at the source (e.g. UFT, UFT-2). It is a Harvester internal key, not a name.
columnHints.repository: Repository name as registered at the source. Opens the repository page.
columnHints.institution: Institution responsible for the repository, according to the source.
columnHints.harvest: The most recent harvest: status, number, date and how many records it brought.
columnHints.managers: How many users have access to this repository.
columnHints.invalid: Share of records that failed validation in the last harvest. A harvest that was never indexed shows as not evaluated.
